Republic describes its Solana security-token standard as having ‘access-control functions, meaning only pre-approved wallets can receive or send tokens, with freeze, clawback, and mint and burn functions’. Subscription runs through the Republic platform with a $50 minimum and a $5,000 initial cap; tokens are locked from resale or transfer for 12 months and thereafter tradable only on the Republic Secondary Market ‘with other investors’.

OpenDeal Inc., the Republic group parent, is the manager of RepublicX LLC; the Form D/A adds a note on intercompany payments to OpenDeal Inc. subsidiaries. The intended post-lockup venue is the Republic Secondary Market, an affiliate venue.

RepublicX LLC’s entire filing history is a Form D and Form D/A under Rule 506(c). There is no Form C, C/A, C-U or C-AR, no registration statement and no periodic report — yet the product was marketed as a Regulation Crowdfunding offering ‘open to all’, and Reg CF requires a Form C before any offer is made.

Per-token wallet whitelisting through the Securitize Connect API, enforced on-chain by defaultAccountState=Frozen. ‘Access to Tokenized SECZ is restricted to holders who meet the onboarding requirements of Securities Markets, LLC, a SEC registered and FINRA member broker dealer’, with onboarding, KYC/AML verification and jurisdictional eligibility checks. Eligible U.S. investors are the target market, which inverts the usual tokenized-equity geofence.

S-4 effective 2026-06-05, 8-A12B 2026-06-30, S-1 filed 2026-07-31 with EFFECT 2026-08-07. Uniquely in this dataset the tokenized form is described inside a registration statement, i.e. under Securities Act liability, rather than only in press releases. No relief for the tokenized form was located.

Operates the Opening Bell platform: onboards issuers, mints the tokens representing their book-entry shares, runs the Allowlist program that thaws holder accounts, and operates the Direct Issuance Program. ‘Investors cannot trade directly on Superstate.’

Both sender and receiver must be on Superstate’s Allowlist: ‘Tokenized Shares may only be transferred to or held by digital wallet addresses of persons or decentralized exchange pools on the Allowlist’, enforced by defaultAccountState=Frozen plus the Allowlist program holding freeze authority. Uniquely in this dataset the allowlist is publicly enumerable (827 accounts on 2026-09-16).

An approved, KYC’d Superstate account is required to tokenize, to burn back to book-entry and to be allowlisted; onboarding needs a government ID with real-time image capture plus SSN and date of birth. Accredited-investor status is NOT required and eligible investors are accepted globally, excluding US-sanctioned jurisdictions.

Registers Superstate Services LLC as a transfer agent under Exchange Act s.17A(c)(2) and Rules 17Ad-1 to 17Ad-21 (including the Rule 17Ad-17 lost-shareholder rule); the underlying shares are registered under effective Securities Act registration statements and the issuers are Exchange Act reporting companies.
